description.narrative: THE NETWORK WILL SERVE AS AN INTER-INSTITUCIONAL COORDINATION MECHANISM OF A TEMPORARY NATURE, WHICH WILL ASSURE THAT CERTAIN SOCIAL PROGRAM RESOURCES EXTENDED TO EXISTING INSTITUTIONS ARE TARGETED TO THE POOREST GROUPS IN THE POPULATION. RESOURCES WILL FINANCE PROGRAMS IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: SOCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE, VOCATIONAL TRAINING, MATERNAL AND INFANT CARE, NUTRITION FOR PRE-SCHOOL CHILDREN, TRANSFERS TO THE ELDERLY, HOUSING AND PARKS.
